title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
summary: 论文分析了在线策略扩散蒸馏（OPD）在分类器自由引导（CFG）下的行为，发现现有方法直接匹配引导速度会导致分支级欠识别问题：正负分支误差可相互补偿。通过对比案例，指出在共享负条件时朴素匹配有效，但模型原生CFG模式保留教师特权信息时存在问题。

extra.description: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities.
